1.

Up, my soul, thy God doth lead thee! No power can hinder thee. Look but up! His hand prepareth Thee a free and levelled path. When the desert’s heat would slay thee, When thou wholly faintest wouldst, Living waters fresh shall flow there At thy foot, if thou but look.

2.

Grace’s light around thee burneth, Where thou goest. But give heed! Glory’s sun shall rise one day in Everlasting majesty. God, thy God, for ever feedeth Thee and standeth ever by; For Egypt’s strokes thou bleedest Now no more, for thou art free.

3.

On our way we get to know how Every sorrow and distress Is exchanged for grace; our God shall Ever be our portion, our firm stay. God giveth us in the midst of the world Soul’s food at the table of grace, Giveth us on the toilsome journey The eagle’s strength and the eagle’s courage.

4.

When at last by the Father’s hand Into the land of peace we go, Where we, loosed from every bond, The Lamb’s song of praise may sing, Well known is the God who meeteth us, Well known our Father’s voice; Here in the desert He tendeth us, There we rest upon His breast.
